svg.title: Automated Data Annotation Pipeline
svg.desc: Eight steps: Data selection; Unified format; Data cleaning; Keyframes + semantics; Visual annotation; Sample construction; LLM review; Human review. LLM review feeds back to keyframes and semantics to revise prompts and rules. Human review audits 300 pairs, 100 each from DROID, MolmoAct and RH20T, across four text aspects and nine slot categories.
